inlines.v: TURF'ING-SPADE, noun An instrument for under-cutting turf, when marked out by the plow. TURF'-MOSS, noun A tract of turfy, mossy, or boggy land. TURF'-SPADE, noun A spade for cutting and digging turf, longer and narrower than the common spade.
